name: census-bar-heading
title: Census Bar Heading
description: A headline where each word carries a data bar underneath whose width encodes a value — typography and chart fused into one element, so a sentence can literally show its own distribution.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Hover Readout: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
